notes.content: Courses required for the major must be taken for a traditional letter grade, except for courses that are offered CR/NR only. Students must earn a C- or better in any course applied to the major. Students interested in declaring a global studies major are urged to take Math 165 (or equivalent) to meet the GE requirement for mathematics, category B4.

notes.content: Intermediate level proficiency in a modern language other than English is required, which is typically met by completing a fourth semester standard language course with a grade of C or better. With department approval, the requirement may be waived if proficiency in a language has been met through prior language study, study abroad, or test credit.
